mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for two consecutive months reduces near-term discounting of corporate earnings, lowering the present value of future cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Rising inflationary bias in the Fed’s policy framework
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the high-rate period (p > 0.10 in a two-tailed test), or the Fed reverses rate hikes within the next month and forward returns turn positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month following a negative monthly pay growth (PAYEMS), it indicates accelerating inflation expectations that compress equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns remain non-negative during such inflationary wage deceleration episodes, or the interaction coefficient (p-value > 0.05 in a two-way F-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months predicts stronger consumer demand, which translates into positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the labor signal, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.10 in a regression with controls for macro variables).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer demand indicators (HOUST) below their 50th percentile for two consecutive months signals a dual softening in economic activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 50th percentile AND HOUST < 50th percentile for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during such dual softening episodes, or the interaction effect is not robust (p > 0.05 in a two-variable Granger causality test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 10% in a quarter coincides with a sharp decline in consumer confidence proxies (not available in this catalog), but here we proxy with a sustained drop in RSAFS below 400,000 for two months, indicating supply-side stress that depresses growth expectations and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO[+3mo] < INDPRO[+1mo] * 0.9 AND RSAFS < 400000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero during supply contraction (p > 0.10 in a rolling regression window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment claims (not available) or proxy: a prolonged decline in UNRATE below 4.5% for four consecutive months reduces labor market optimism and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days (always-on signal).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are consistently positive during periods of falling UNRATE below 4.5%, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.10 in a rolling regression).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of GDPC1 exceeds the prior quarter’s level by at least 5%, it reflects robust consumer spending momentum that supports higher future earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (p > 0.10) during such acceleration, or the effect reverses in the next quarter’s data.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive double-dip in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend (defined as two consecutive months falling below INDPRO’s 40th percentile) suggests persistent supply-side weakness that, when combined with falling consumer confidence proxies (not available), is expected to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days (interaction-driven signal using only available proxies).
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 40th percentile for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during such episodes, or the interaction is not significant (p > 0.05 in a single-variable model).
